title: OFFER AGREEMENT AND PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING POLICY
body:
This document is an official public offer (public offer) of LLP Sergei Zamkovoi (hereinafter referred to as the "Contractor") to any individual (hereinafter referred to as the "User") who accepts this offer on the terms specified below.

Payment by the User for the Contractor's Services on the website https://zamkovoi.yoga or its subdomain pages constitutes full and unconditional acceptance (acceptance) of the terms of this Agreement, which is equivalent to concluding an agreement on the terms set forth herein. In the event of disagreement with any terms of this document, the Contractor recommends refraining from using the provided services.

1. TERMS AND DEFINITIONS
1.1. The term "Offer" means a public offer of the Contractor addressed to any individual to conclude an agreement on the terms contained in this document.
1.2. The term "Acceptance" means full and unconditional acceptance by the User of the terms of the Agreement by making payment for the Services.
1.3. The term "Services" means individual and group training of citizens according to the author's programs of self-regulation, healthy lifestyle, practical psychology and yoga, including the provision of methodological teaching materials, formation of individual recommendations and lesson plans, as well as conducting regular interactive consultations (webinars) with feedback.

2. SUBJECT OF THE AGREEMENT
2.1. The Contractor undertakes to provide the User with educational and consulting services on teaching psychology, yoga and self-regulation practices in accordance with the training program selected by the User, and the User undertakes to pay for these services.
2.2. All Services under this Agreement are provided by the Contractor personally. No hired teaching staff are engaged. A license for educational activity is not required in accordance with the current legislation of the Russian Federation.
2.3. Access to the database of recorded video materials, breathing and other techniques, as well as to educational literature (books) is provided to the User solely as additional educational (methodological) aids for preparing for live interactive classes with the Contractor in the format of group or individual consultations and webinars. Access to these materials may be provided on the website, in Telegram, or in the mobile application "Harmonizer", recognized by the Parties solely as a technical tool (user cabinet) for accessing materials and performing educational tasks.

3. PROCEDURE FOR PROVIDING SERVICES AND PAYMENT
3.1. To receive the Services, the User independently selects the Training Program (course, workshop, intensive, masterclass or tariff plan) on the Contractor's Website, registers and makes payment.
3.2. Payment is made non-cash using Internet acquiring directly on the Contractor's Website.
3.3. Services may be provided on the terms of a regular monthly subscription (recurring payments). In this case, by making the first payment, the User gives consent to the Contractor and the payment service provider for automatic debiting of funds from the User's bank card once a month in the amount of the selected tariff until the User independently cancels the subscription in the Personal Account.

4. PAYMENT SECURITY POLICY
4.1. Information is transmitted to the payment gateway using SSL encryption technology over closed banking networks with the highest level of reliability. The security of Internet payment processing is guaranteed by the payment service used. All operations are carried out in accordance with the requirements of payment systems.
4.2. The personal information provided by the User (e-mail, bank card number) is strictly confidential and not subject to disclosure to third parties. Your bank card data is transmitted only in encrypted form and is not stored on the Contractor's server.

5. PRIVACY POLICY AND PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING
5.1. By accepting this Offer, the User gives his unconditional consent to the Contractor (Data Operator) for the processing of his personal data (last name, first name, patronymic, e-mail address, phone number, date, time and place of birth) in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ "On Personal Data".
5.2. Personal data processing is carried out solely for the purposes of: identifying the User, proper execution of this Training Agreement, sending organizational notifications and answering the User's questions within the educational process.
5.3. The Contractor undertakes to ensure the confidentiality of the User's personal data and take necessary legal, organizational and technical measures to protect it from unlawful, accidental or unauthorized access, destruction, modification or copying by third parties.

6. LIABILITY OF THE PARTIES AND MEDICAL LIMITATIONS
6.1. Training in yoga and self-regulation practices involves physical and breathing loads. The User personally confirms that he is familiar with the nature of the loads, has no medical contraindications and assumes full responsibility for his health. The Contractor's Services are not medical care and do not replace consultations or prescriptions of a doctor.
6.2. Refund of funds for actually unrendered Services is made upon a reasoned written application of the User sent to the Contractor's e-mail within 14 calendar days after payment. From the moment access to the program's methodological materials is provided or a live interactive webinar is conducted, the service in this part is considered fully rendered and is not subject to refund.

7. DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND FINAL PROVISIONS
7.1. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the current legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. All disputes and disagreements arising between the Parties shall be resolved through mandatory amicable negotiations. If no agreement is reached during pre-trial settlement (deadline for responding to a claim - 30 days), the dispute is subject to judicial consideration at the place of registration of the Contractor.
7.2. The Contractor has the right to unilaterally make changes to the terms of this Agreement without prior agreement with the User.
